question: Why use drones, and could this be built without them?
answer: For the papers' demo objects, yes: a gantry or robot arm would be faster and more accurate. Drones earn their place only when at least one condition below holds.

use_drones_if.condition: The structure is larger than any machine you could put around it
The work is at height, remote, post-disaster or a repair in place
Ground space is congested or the build blocks ground circulation
The form would need scaffolding that grows with span

gains.text: No machine envelope to design inside
The build corrects itself every layer

costs.text: About one layer per trip; 72 trips for a 2.05 m tower
~5 mm, only with a delta arm
Every interim stage must be checked
Lab and simulation only so far
